sentences.text: Nyx, a 7-year-old female Domestic Shorthair, neuter status not recorded, carries a possible foreign material flag: the AI photo read of the May 23 vomit noted a possible plastic fragment, unconfirmed, and the photo was not retained.
Vomiting has 23 entries on 23 of 43 logged days over at least 47 days, first logged May 14 with onset unknown, and was logged on 4 of the 7 days to Jun 30, her latest entries.
The record covers 43 of 90 days, 4 of the first 45 and 39 of the last 45, with nothing logged Jul 1 to 2.
She is free-fed Nature's Variety Duck and Royal Canin Weight Care, which lists chicken, all day, intake not directly observed, and no food could be isolated, with chicken in her all-day kibble.
